Record Class TableRows.Column

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.atomictempest.core.settings.TableRows.Column
Record Components:
name - what the column is, shown over it ("Price", "Featured"); short, it is a narrow column
Enclosing class:
TableRows
public static record TableRows.Column(String name, double min, double max, int decimals, boolean check, TableRows.Kind kind) extends Record
One field of every row: a number between min and max, a tick box, or words (up to max letters).

      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal.
